objective: Test effective correct-state memory amplitude by multiplying every eval-time Q/O raw memory delta before fusion, recovering scene recall without losing the full-strength memory precision advantage.

prior_exposure.claim_boundary: This is post-validation TRAIN-derived mechanism development. It may nominate one controller strength for fresh replication but cannot change the accepted validation decoder or create a new native benchmark claim.

intervention.controller: For head_name in {q,o}, return reference + raw_delta converted to reference dtype times the fixed strength. Reject every other head, training mode, shape, dtype, or device change.
intervention.scope: All 42 wrapped layers, both Q and O raw memory deltas, during write and read forward passes.
intervention.full_strength_generation: Reuse signed correct-state v9 outputs from natural_memory_native_routed_benchmark_v1_r2.
intervention.zero_strength_generation: Reuse signed base-like zero-state outputs from natural_memory_native_scene_causal_router_v1.

preflight.reason: Historically exposed selection rows excluded from every reported fit and holdout metric.
preflight.stopping_rule: Do not generate fit candidates unless a signed preflight receipt passes every requirement.

data_scope.partition_rule: Compute SHA-256('rwkv-ms-scale-v1:' + target row SHA-256); holdout iff the unsigned integer from the first eight hex characters modulo five equals zero, otherwise fit.

two_phase_stopping_rule.phase_one: After passing preflight, generate all four effective strengths for fit targets only. Holdout targets are forbidden.
two_phase_stopping_rule.selection_candidates: The four effective intermediate strengths plus reused full-strength 1.0.
two_phase_stopping_rule.selection_ordering: micro-F1 descending, precision descending, recall descending, strength ascending
two_phase_stopping_rule.phase_two_authorization: Only if every phase-one gate passes, sign and push selection.json naming one intermediate strength before generating holdout targets.
two_phase_stopping_rule.phase_two: Generate only the signed selected strength for the 73 holdout targets exactly once.

stopping_rule: Archive, commit, and push preflight, phase one, and any authorized phase two whether pass or fail. Never read publisher-validation predictions, publisher test, or Hard32.
